evals.name: logs-are-not-a-briefing
evals.prompt: 只起草 PR 正文，不发布。改动解决发放接口重复请求导致重复入账，网页重试复用 ID，范围不含持久化。实际已观察：模拟入账后响应丢失再重试只入账一次，网页刷新余额不变。证据存放在 https://example.org/run/api 和 https://example.org/run/web ，独立验收仍待完成。作者原文是 src/a.ts src/b.ts npm test 500 passed HEAD=abc。请按技能重写。不要把待验收描述为已通过。
expectations: Uses five required H2 sections in order, Tradeoffs only if a real choice exists.
Describes problem, behavior, scope and risk instead of a path/command/log inventory.
Verification links each operation and observed result; independent verdict is explicitly pending.
Does not invent measurements or publish.

evals.name: no-proof-and-required-project-template
evals.prompt: 只起草不发布：项目必须使用 Summary / Test plan / Risk 三段。修复刷新后重复扣款；仅 typecheck 通过，真实重试和刷新没有跑。请写 PR，说明默认格式检查怎么处理，不能声称功能已验证。
expectations: Honors the mandatory project template and maps briefing responsibilities into it.
Explicitly states behavior proof pending; typecheck alone is not proof.
Does not alter project requirements to satisfy the bundled default checker.
